description: Copy from URL — Downloads a public URL and stores it at the requested remote path.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

autoFilename.description: Set to true to derive the destination filename from the URL.

fs.description: Remote name or path that will receive the downloaded file, e.g. `drive:`.

remote.description: Destination path within `fs` where the fetched object will be stored.

url.description: Source URL to fetch the object from.

name: operations_copyurl
